name: Code
description: The Code tab in the Workspace: sessions with workers, their conversations, permission questions, tickets.

views.name: Code
views.template: {{#if not data.x}}Loading …{{#else}}

flow.name: work.start
flow.title: Start a session
flow.description: A new session (a new todo and a worker on it): input instruction, ticket, repoId, provider, repoPath, branch, workspace, mode, model, effort, elevated. Output { runId }.

items.title: Send a message into a session

flow.name: work.send
flow.title: Send a message into a session
flow.description: Your next message in a session's conversation (input run, text). Output { runId }.

items.title: Do something in a live session

flow.name: work.live
flow.title: Do something in a live session
flow.description: Send, answer an ask, interrupt, switch the mode (input run, do, text, requestId, behavior, always, message, interrupt, then, answers, mode, option).

views.name: Code settings
views.template:

flow.name: work.setting
flow.title: Change a Code setting
flow.description: One setting changed (input scope: work | claude, field, value). Output { message }.

flow.name: work.repo-save
flow.title: Add or change a repo
flow.description: A repo for workers (input id, name, path, gitlabProject, boards, tickets, instructions, delivery).

items.title: How a repo's work is delivered

flow.name: work.repo-delivery
flow.title: How a repo's work is delivered
flow.description: A repo's delivery only: mr | direct (input id, delivery).

flow.name: work.repo-delete
flow.title: Remove a repo
flow.description: A repo off the list; its folder is not touched (input id).

flow.name: work.branch
flow.title: Switch a session's branch
flow.description: The branch a session works on (input run, branch). Output { message }.

flow.name: work.dangling-end
flow.title: Kill all dangling sessions
flow.description: Every dangling session stopped, the workers free. Output { message }.

items.title: Set up or remove automatic admin sessions

flow.name: work.admin
flow.title: Set up or remove automatic admin sessions
flow.description: input do: install | remove | uac. Output { message }.

flow.name: work.attach
flow.title: Attach a file or picture
flow.description: A file the upload brought, kept for the next message (input scope: new | run:<id>, token, name). Output { ref, name, size }.

flow.name: work.attach-remove
flow.title: Take an attachment off
flow.description: One waiting attachment, or all of a scope (input scope, ref).

flow.name: work.repo-systems
flow.title: Read the repos' systems
flow.description: The systems of all repos read from the knowledge again. Output { message }.

items.title: Commit, push, merge request, dev servers

flow.name: work.git
flow.title: Commit, push, merge request, dev servers
flow.description: In a session's folder: input run, do (commit | push | mr | proc-start | proc-stop), message, title, name. Output { message, url }.

flow.name: work.stop
flow.title: Stop a session's run
flow.description: A run stopped or taken out of the queue (input run).

flow.name: work.archive
flow.title: Archive a session
flow.description: A session out of the list, or back (input todo, archived: true | false).

flow.name: work.delete
flow.title: Delete a session
flow.description: A session deleted for good — its runs and logs; its todo stays (input todo).
